events.text: Ionel Turturică founded FC Buzău, which was enrolled in Liga V – Buzău County, after the bankruptcy of FC Gloria Buzău.
events.date_text: After the bankruptcy of FC Gloria Buzău
events.subject: self
events.quote: After the bankruptcy of FC Gloria Buzău , businessman Ionel Turturică founded a new club , FC Buzău

events.text: FC Buzău promoted to Liga IV after only one season.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After only one season , the new club , which also had players with many matches played for FC Gloria Buzău , promoted to Liga IV

events.text: FC Buzău was renamed as SCM Gloria Buzău in the summer of 2017.

events.text: SCM Gloria Buzău promoted to Liga II in the 2018–19 season after winning the first series of the third tier.
